title: The plan's published writes go through one store interface, with a conformance test (Part B of seven)
summary: Part B of seven: new package store/ (PlanStore, FolderStore, SurfaceStore, Repo.store) with text, JSON, byte, folder and config writes; every published write of the CLI and the board goes through it, check_publish first; no behaviour change, no refusal yet (Part C's). Needs nothing.
